newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMRO SAYS JAN-OCT SALES ROSE 20 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: TAMRO SAYS JAN-OCT SALES ROSE 20 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Tamro Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its January-October sales increased 20 percent year-on-year to 10.4 billion markka.
The group's pharmaceuticals sales increased 21 percent to 9.7 billion markka.
Tamro's market share in Finland rose to 62 percent from 61 percent in the year-ago period, the company said. In Sweden, in January-September its market share fell one percentage point to 62 percent.
